dct_description_sm: Field data was collected in order to determine the long-term impacts of permafrost disturbances (active layer detachments) on vegetation and to define the site characteristics of these disturbances. Data were collected from six relic active layer detachments located throughout the East and West Watersheds in two moisture classification zones, polar desert and mesic heath areas, which was compared to determine the role of soil moisture in site recovery.
dct_title_s: 2010 Impact of  permafrost disturbance on tundra vegetation, Cape Bounty
